about: Profession packs (queue profession-packs): what each kind of working life needs that a generic app misses: the licences and renewals that must never lapse, the risks and the cover that protects against them, how the income behaves and the tax route that usually fits, the next rung, and three systems that run without willpower. Paraphrased from public practice, verified on the date shown; rules differ by state, council and employer, so each pack says where to confirm. Not legal, tax or medical advice.

packs.title: Salaried, private sector

renewals.t: Tax regime choice declared to the employer
renewals.how: Compare both regimes on the Savings levers card, then declare before the first payroll of the year.

renewals.t: Health cover beyond the group policy
renewals.how: Group cover ends with the job: keep a personal policy (or a top-up) in force so a job change never leaves the family uncovered.

renewals.t: Form 16 and AIS checked against your own records
renewals.how: Before filing, match salary, TDS and interest in the AIS; ask HR to correct a mismatch early.

risks.t: Sudden job loss or a restructuring
risks.cover: Six months of essential costs in the emergency fund, a personal health policy, a CV and three referees kept current.

risks.t: Income concentrated in one employer and its stock
risks.cover: Sell vested stock on a fixed rule; keep no more than a small share of net worth in the employer.

income.pattern: Steady monthly salary with yearly bonus and stock; the step-ups come from moves, not tenure.
income.tax: Salary under the cheaper regime each year; employer NPS (up to the policy share of basic) is not taxed in the new regime.

ladder: Deep skill in one area, known for one result
Leads a team or a product with a number it owns
Owns a P&L or a function
Runs a business unit or the company

systems.name: Career moves on purpose
systems.step: Update the one-line result you delivered this quarter; message one person in your network
systems.review: Each year: is the next rung in sight, or is it time to move?

systems.name: The money floor
systems.step: The SIP and the emergency fund move before anything is spent
systems.reward: The North Star's redundancy part rises

systems.name: Recover from long days
systems.step: A two-minute shutdown: tomorrow's one task, then off
systems.review: Sunday: energy scores of the week

packs.confirm: Your employer's HR policies and the income-tax site

packs.title: Government and public sector

renewals.t: Annual property return to your department
renewals.how: Most services ask for an annual return of immovable property by a fixed date; keep the register of assets, loans and gifts current through the year so it takes minutes. Check your service rules for the date and the form.

renewals.t: Intimation or permission before buying or selling property, or large gifts
renewals.how: Conduct rules usually require prior intimation or sanction above a value: check yours before you sign anything.
Check the NPS statement (or GPF) for every month's contribution; raise a missing credit with the drawing office early.

risks.t: Transfers and postings that split the family
risks.cover: A family plan for schooling and a second home base; keep documents scanned and shared.

risks.t: Conduct-rule breaches by accident (side income, gifts, social media)
risks.cover: A one-page list of what needs permission; ask before, never after.

income.pattern: Steady pay with dearness allowance revisions and pay commissions; pension or NPS by rule.
income.tax: Salary; the new regime often wins unless home-loan interest and other deductions are large: compare each year.

ladder: Clears the probation and the first postings with a clean record
Leads a unit; known for one reform delivered
Heads a division or a district-level charge

systems.name: The asset register that writes the annual return
systems.cue: Any purchase, sale, loan or gift
systems.step: One line in the register the same day
systems.reward: The annual return is ready in minutes
systems.review: Every January, before the return is due

systems.name: Ask before you act
systems.cue: Any side income, investment in a new asset class, or public writing
systems.step: Check the one-page list; send the intimation first

systems.name: Posting-proof family life
systems.step: The relocation checklist: school, health records, address changes
systems.reward: The move takes days, not months

packs.confirm: Your service's conduct rules and the drawing and disbursing office

packs.title: Doctors and clinicians

renewals.how: Your state medical (or dental) council sets the renewal period and the CME credit points needed; keep a running CME log so renewal is a formality. Check your council's current rule.
Renew before it lapses; match the cover to your specialty's risk and keep the policy where your practice can find it.

renewals.t: Clinic registrations and licences (if you run a practice)
renewals.how: Clinical establishment registration, biomedical waste authorisation, fire safety and, where used, radiation equipment licences: each has its own renewal date.

risks.cover: Indemnity insurance sized to the specialty, consent records kept, a lawyer known in advance.

risks.t: Burnout and irregular sleep from on-call work
risks.cover: A recovery floor (sleep, one protected day), and the daily three kept tiny on call days.

risks.t: Income that stops when you stop working (in private practice)
risks.cover: Disability income cover and a larger emergency fund than a salaried person needs.

income.pattern: Salary in a hospital; in private practice, fees that rise with reputation and stop when you stop.
income.tax: Salary, or for a practice, professional income (the presumptive route may fit small practices: confirm with a chartered accountant).

ladder: Registered and trained; the first independent cases
Known for one procedure or condition
Leads a department or a practice with its own referrals
Teaches, publishes, or builds an institution

systems.name: CME without a scramble
systems.step: One line in the CME log with its credit points and certificate

systems.name: On-call recovery
systems.step: The recovery floor: sleep first, the daily three at their smallest

systems.name: Practice compliance calendar
systems.step: Every licence and insurance renewal dated in the calendar

packs.confirm: Your state medical or dental council, and your indemnity insurer

packs.title: Licensed professionals
covers: cyber law and digital forensics experts

renewals.how: Bar council, ICAI, IAI or the Council of Architecture: each has a yearly fee or a periodic certificate; pay early and keep the receipt.
Your body sets the hours or credits (often in multi-year blocks); log each session the day you attend.
Renew before it lapses; size it to the largest engagement you sign.

risks.cover: Indemnity insurance, engagement letters that cap scope, and files kept for the limitation period.

risks.t: A conflict of interest or an ethics complaint
risks.cover: A conflict check before every new client, recorded.
Pay yourself a fixed monthly draw; keep six to nine months in reserve.

income.pattern: Salary in a firm, or fees and a share of profits as a partner; lumpy when you practise alone.
income.tax: Salary, or professional income (presumptive taxation may fit up to the limit when receipts are mostly by bank: confirm with a chartered accountant); GST registration above the services threshold.

ladder: Qualified and admitted; the first matters of your own
Known for one kind of matter
Partner or practice owner with your own clients
Leads a practice area or a firm

systems.name: CPE logged as you go
systems.step: One line in the log with hours and proof

systems.name: A fixed monthly draw
systems.step: Move the draw to the household account; the rest stays in the reserve
systems.reward: The household runs on a steady income

packs.confirm: Your bar council, institute or council, and your indemnity insurer
